subject: ApertureAI pricing & capacity review — coordinate attendee availability

Hi Samir / Laura,

Thanks for the productive discovery last week — appreciate the clarity on your expected monthly token volumes and peak qps. We want to lock a 30–45 minute working session next week to walk through:

- Usage forecast you shared (attached) and how that maps to Dedicated sizing options
- Packaging/pricing scenarios (burst vs committed) and estimated monthly costs
- Procurement timeline items (PO/contracting) and any security evidence you’ll need

Suggested attendees: AE (Soojin), Solutions Eng (Vivek), Procurement lead (Laura / procurement@apertureai.com), and one of your infra/engineers to validate qps numbers.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 5/19 10:30–11:15
- Tue 5/19 15:00–15:45
- Wed 5/20 09:00–09:45

Please reply with the slot that works best, and I’ll send an invite. I’ve attached the initial usage forecast you sent for reference.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee

- Tue 5/19 14:30–15:15

- Typical lead time for PO setup and signatory routing at Redwood
